selection: Exactly the original three frozen Codex root-task Apple pilot inputs, convenience selected before this cutoff experiment; no replacement or outcome selection.
execution: One fresh eval process per input and variant; deterministic preregistered within-input order; cache disabled. Each command bounded to 270 seconds and 8 MiB total captured output. Apple uses only the pinned on-device bridge, under the mac-native scheduler. Remote scorer and judge settings are removed; isolated config/data roots.
metrics: new structural verifier findings versus each source
Apple model calls, overlays, failed batches and fallback diagnostics
no_op_rule: A no-op retains the counterpart variant's pre-edit probe set unchanged when available. If both variants have no plan, probes remain unavailable; no invented perfect score.
failure_rule: Retain every registered input and outcome. Do not substitute heuristic fallback for successful Apple qualification. If a command fails, its metrics stay unavailable and it remains in failure counts.
limitations: Three convenience inputs from one Mac; this qualifies the Apple-plus-cutoff execution mechanism only.
Both variants use the preregistered 0.5 threshold; this does not tune or establish an optimal threshold.
Apple overlays at most 32 selected candidates; unscored candidates retain heuristic scores. Heuristic remainder is expected coverage, distinct from backend failure fallback.
Literal string survival is not semantic understanding, task correctness, or resume qualification. Protected-tail probes can be absent.
Token changes are offline estimates, not measured provider-billed savings, live context, cache cost, or productivity.
One pass without repeatability or model cold/warm control; timings are descriptive and model outputs may vary.
Raw inputs, input hashes, selected line positions, prompts, responses and missed probes are never public.
privacy: Aggregate methodology only. Private inputs, input hashes, selected line positions, prompts, responses, missed probes and per-input records are excluded.
